about.title: Computer Science Engineering Student & Aspiring AI/ML Engineer
about.shortBio: I build web applications, explore AI-powered solutions, and continuously improve my technical skills through hands-on projects, competitions, certifications, and real-world experiences.
about.fullBio: I am a Computer Science Engineering student at St. Peter's Engineering College (2025–2029) driven by a passion for Web Development, Python programming, and Artificial Intelligence. Through active involvement in technical events, hackathons, and project teams like SPECIANCIENS, I focus on solving practical problems, collaborating with peers, and building impactful digital applications.

projects.title: AI Life Decision Simulator
projects.shortDescription: An interactive web application that simulates the outcomes of different life and career decisions using AI-driven logic.
projects.fullDescription: The AI Life Decision Simulator is an interactive web-based tool created to assist students and individuals in evaluating complex life choices, academic pathways, and career trajectories. By modeling conditional decision trees and smart decision logic, the application visualizes short-term and long-term consequences of different career choices.
projects.contribution: End-to-end development of interactive user interface, decision calculation logic, and responsive UI design.
challenges: Designing intuitive UI flows for branching decision trees without backend complexity
Ensuring smooth responsive layout across mobile and desktop devices
learned: Front-end state management in standard JavaScript
Designing user-centric logic flow for interactive decision support tools

projects.title: SA // BASECAMP

projects.shortDescription: A web platform developed for SPECIANCIENS to support alumni-student engagement, mentorship, and career networking.
projects.fullDescription: SA // BASECAMP serves as the digital bridge connecting current engineering students with alumni of St. Peter's Engineering College. It streamlines alumni involvement, mentorship initiatives, student project showcases, and industry guidance programs.
projects.contribution: Projects Team involvement, front-end development, platform features, and student-alumni engagement workflows.
challenges: Structuring a cohesive layout suitable for both student viewers and alumni professionals
Collaborating effectively within a multi-member project team
learned: Designing student-alumni engagement features for institutional platforms
